notes.title: St. Patrick's Day Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy St.Patrick's Day![/h1]

[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

Over the last few months, we've been hard at work planning the next steps for Clan O'Conall. As a result, we've batched a number of small but important improvements to the game to fix outstanding issues. We've also introduced some cool new features to bring the joy of exploration to Hibernia once again.

[i]Overall Fixes[/i]

[list]
[*] Many, many major performance optimizations across the whole game to address frame drops and loading issues.
[*] Many fixes, adjustments, and slight improvements to art and visuals, primarily addressing elements which were layered or parallaxing incorrectly
[*] Clackshot’s upgrade “Touch the Sky” now correctly reflects non-fire projectiles as intended by  performing a double or triple jump
[*] Clackshot’s Grapple Hook ability has improved visual feedback for when she is within range of a green grapple attach point
[*] Adjusted volume of background music in most levels.,
[/list]

[i]Improved Camera Features[/i]

[list]
[*][b]*NEW* Zoom Toggle:[/b] When the camera is zoomed out beyond a certain threshold, players will be prompted with an icon on-screen to toggle between a more zoomed-in view as they choose.
[*] [b]Character Tracker: [/b]When the character is small on screen, they will be encircled with a coloured ring so that they are not lost by the player’s eye.
[*] [b]Look Down:[/b] Crouching will cause the camera to pan down, allowing the player to safely check for hazards below. What innovation!
[/list]

[i]Level Changes[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Level 1 -[/b] The Valley of Heroes: awards 50 more fairies for enemy kill completion
[*] [b]Level 14 - [/b]Added an unstable platform to one of the late puzzles in the level, making it easier for the player to pick up another bomb to reattempt when they are blocked by the breakable wall
[*] [b]Level 20 -[/b] The Mother of Demons: added a checkpoint prior to starting the final boss phase
[*] [b]Level 20 - [/b]The Mother of Demons: improved visual feedback in the final boss phase - it’s more clear that the player is making progress on the boss through the first few cycles, and there is an on-screen arrow directing them back toward the center of the level when the boss switches sides
[*] Removed 10 enemies from Level 9, 5 from Level 13, and 5 from Level 14 for game pacing purposes (the levels’ max Fairy rewards for enemy kills remain the same)
[*] Streamlining adjustments to the final puzzle of Level 14
[*] Streamlining adjustments to the first puzzle of Level 19
[*] Edits to the section with many fireball spinners on Level 19 to improve its flow
[/list]

[i]Character Balancing[/i]

[list]
[*] Increased the damage dealt by Haggish’s Up and Down directional attacks (Uppercut and Slam attacks)
[*] Increased the range for a ledge grab to successfully attach, it should feel more forgiving and responsive now
[*] Characters now perform a lower-height hop when leaping up to the ledge from a ledge grab. The result is that the character now lands after the ledge hop quicker and is able to act out of it sooner
[/list]

notes.title: The Monsters & Mayhem Update is Live!
notes.content:
Summer is almost over and we wanted to introduce some new features into the game based on player feedback. These are things we’ve wanted to add for a while! 

That’s why we’re happy to announce the Monsters & Mayhem Update, including a new Accessibility Pause option for Swaps, and Game Difficulty!


[h3]Character Swap-Pause  Option[/h3]
Finding it challenging to swap precisely when you have a boar on your tail? Say no more! 

Within the Gameplay section of the pause menu, we added this handy new feature that will give a brief pause to the gameplay every time you switch to a new character, allowing you to prepare your next move or correct the swap if you mistakenly selected the wrong sibling for the job. You can turn this on and off anytime you want!  

[h3]Combat Difficulty Setting[/h3]
We want everybody to play at the level they want so we made an Easy, Normal, and Hard mode for combat! You don’t find enough of a challenge? Switch to Hard and see the hordes of Caoranach deal more damage, making you rely more on dodge moves and precise attacks in order to win battles. On the other hand, if you find the mayhem of battle is too much, keep it on easy so you can focus more on platforming and puzzle-solving.

Check it out below!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vQ5fO5mynfA

We also made a number of fixes to the game itself.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Big Visual improvements to the Dreaded Dullahan! Dullahan’s head now has a much more prominent visual effect when its invulnerable. We’ve also added better indicators to the Stone Head and Faulty Bomb to show that Haggish can interact with them.
[*] Red Skulls now consistently reflect back at Dullahan, fixing an issue where some would not behave correctly.
[*] Fixed a problem area where a player could get stuck in a platform during a vine dash in Level 5
[*] Fixed the issue in Caoránach’s first arena where you can ledge grab by mistake.
[*] The Fireball Tunnel in Level 7 now welcomes you with a stream of continuous fireballs.
[*] Kilcannon’s swapping responsiveness has been improved while he’s gliding.
[*] Air Vents now refresh Kilcannon’s air dodge.
[*] Fruit Bombs may now be thrown to destroy flying enemies. 
[*] Haggish’s reflect upgrade has been fixed to be more consistent.
[/list]

[h2]Audio and Visual Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Level 17 now has a tense new music track to fit the theme of the level. Tread carefully!
[*] A ring has been added to Clakshot’s grapple points to help clue in players when they are in range for a grapple. 
[*] The platform layouts on the last boss fight of the game now have a fancy new effect when they appear on screen.
[/list]

Balance Changes

[list]
[*] Checkpoints now restore some Health.
[/list]

notes.title: Hibernian Summer Update - Localization, Speedrun Support, and Visual Polish!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36909267/dd899f0a966a4358813af58c24e34b6fcdf00e7d.png[/img]

[h1]The Hibernian Summer Update is Here![/h1]

[b]Greetings from the Clan![/b]

There's never any rest for the weary, but we did manage to sneak in a few days to relax, recuperate and make headway on our first major update. We wanted to address the biggest improvements we could make, primarily visual and in quality of life.  

Without further ado: please enjoy the Hibernian Summer Update.

[h2]Language Support[/h2]

[i][b]Hola, Salut, and Olá. [/b][/i]Clan O’Conall is now fully localized into Spanish, French, and Portuguese. 

Thank you for all the feedback and support from players in these regions who helped us to get these localizations completed!

[h2]New Game Features![/h2]

[list]
[*] We’ve added a few new features to the play experience to help repeat plays and completionists out. We’ve been keen on following player feedback over the last month to improve a lot of pain points but also to introduce some new quality of life features.
[*] There is now a Speedrunner Timer added to the Gameplay Options menu. The Timer automatically stops during Level Selection, Menus, Pauses, and during Cutscenes to get time tracking down to the millisecond. 
[*] Level selection now provides a tracker for Faeries, Enemies, Secrets, and Best Times. Now looking for that last faerie for an upgrade won’t require you popping in and out of levels.
[*] We’ve added additional sound effects for the Upgrade Screen, the Mushroom Bounce Pad, and Dagda’s Rage attack.
[*] Cutscenes now have a “Hold to Skip” feature to avoid accidentally skipping through cutscenes.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug where Haggish would lose mobility, eventually freezing in place and requiring an exit to the menu..
[*] Fixed a rare bug where Kilcannon’s jumping height would be cut by half.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where Clakshot’s quiver capacity would drop to 6.
[*] Fixed a bug where some camera triggers in level 14 and 17 would stop functioning after respawning.
[*] Dagda’s Rage can no longer prevent the Boar from killing you.
[*] Fruit bombs have more consistent behavior and are generally easier to trigger a detonation than before. Previously, if the bomb touched the ground before sliding into an obstacle or enemy, was dropped instead of thrown into an air vent, or thrown too close to a breakable wall, it may not explode as expected.
[*] Resolved a bug where Haggish’s charge punch would register a hit multiple times.
[*] PS4 Controller now works correctly with Windows.
[/list]

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Final Boss’s fight has visual clarity improvements to its weak point to indicate when the boss is shielded versus when it is not.
[*] Haggish’s ultimate upgrade, Dagda’s Rage, now has a new activation UI. As you damage enemies, you’ll see Fire icons light atop of Haggish’s head. When all icons are lit, you can unleash devastating power!
[*] Small visual polish improvement to the enemies dash indicator line.
[*] More visual polish to levels in World 2.
[*] The Camp of the Dead Army (level 17) has a new ground terrain tile.
[*] The Deadly Peak (level 14) has its many, many spike assets turned to ice assets to better reflect the environment.
[*] Damage numbers now appear where your attack makes an impact with a boss, rather than appearing in the same position every time.
[*] Clakshot’s activated platforms produce a new visual effect when enabled, to better draw the player’s attention and create a more clear link with the switch as it’s shot.
[*] Breakable floors and walls across the game have been swapped out for new assets. Additionally, floors which were intended to be broken by dropping a heavy block onto them now display yellow cracks, and are otherwise resistant to both fruit bombs and Haggish’s destructive attacks.
[/list]

[h2]Other Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Deadly Peak (level 14) last puzzle section has a checkpoint in the middle to save the player's progress partway. A health pickup has also been added to the area, along with some minor layout tweaks to lower the chance of the player facing a setback here.
[*] The camera has also been zoomed out slightly further on Level 14’s last puzzle section to allow for easier navigation and puzzle-solving.
[*] Dullahan’s head will now properly dissolve into a horrible skull after being defeated.
[*] Balor’s maximum health has been lowered slightly. (15,000 -> 13,500)
[*] Balor’s attack patterns have been adjusted for balance: his falling boulders no longer target the player as aggressively, his enemy summons have been altered to imps in both of his phases, and his mid-fight moving platforms use a new, adjusted layout.
[*] Some of Balor’s attacks have had their colour adjusted for consistency with our visual language for whether an attack is dodgeable in a normal fashion, as opposed to “fiery” yellow attacks which can only be dodged using Kilcannon’s “Heart of Lugh” upgrade.
[*] Final boss layouts have been adjusted to cut down on unfair deaths.
[*] Added some extra time to a puzzle section on level 11 before the boar escapes.
[*] General audio-level balancing to get a more even volume across the game. 
[/list]

We do have big news for Clan in the coming weeks, but that's all we can say for now. Stay tuned and thank you for all your support.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Notes

Language Support

Hola, Salut, and Olá. Clan O’Conall is now fully localized into Spanish, French, and Portuguese. 

Thank you to all the feedback and support from players in these regions who helped us to get these localizations completed!

We’ve added a few new features to the play experience to help repeat plays and completionists out. We’ve been keen on following player feedback over the last month to improve a lot of pain points but also to introduce some new quality of life features.
There is now a Speedrunner Timer added to the Gameplay Options menu. The Timer automatically stops during Level Selection, Menus, Pauses and during Cutscenes to get time tracking down to the millisecond. 
Level selection now provides a tracker for Faeries, Enemies, Secrets and Best Times. Now looking for that last faerie for an upgrade won’t require you popping in and out of levels.
We’ve added additional sound effects for the Upgrade Screen, the Mushroom Bounce Pad, and Dagda’s Rage attack.
Cutscenes now have a “Hold to Skip” feature to avoid accidentally skipping through cutscenes.

Previously, if the bomb touched the ground before sliding into an obstacle or enemy, was dropped instead of thrown into an air vent, or thrown too closely to a breakable wall, it may not explode as expected.
Resolved a bug where Haggish’s charge punch would register a hit multiple times.
PS4 Controller now works correctly with Windows.

Visual Improvements

The Final Boss’s fight has visual clarity improvements to its weak point to indicate when the boss is shielded versus when it is not.

Haggish’s ultimate upgrade, Dagda’s Rage, now has a new activation UI. As you damage enemies, you’ll see Fire icons light atop of Haggish’s head. When all icons are lit, you can unleash devastating power!

The camera has also been zoomed out slightly further on Level 14’s last puzzle section to allow for easier navigation and puzzle-solving.

Final boss layouts have been adjusted to cut down on unfair deaths.

notes.title: Week One Updates
notes.content:
[h1]Week One Update - v1.05.1 fixes[/h1]

[b]Hello Everyone![/b]
We have a slate of changes planned for the near future, but we wanted to quickly fix issues that caused the greatest deal of play disruption or otherwise easily noticed issues that commonly occur. We'll have more information about our next major update in the coming week, but please enjoy our first update in the form of v1.05
[h2]Game Fixes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have addressed the issue that prevented credit being awarded for Achievements.
[*] Music has been added to Stages 6 and 9 where previously no music would play.
[*] Adjustments to the second Stage of Caoranach's behavior and visual indicators to make the fight experience more intuitive.
[*] Adjustments to the third Stage of Caoranach to fix the beam attack that was previously not working as intended.
[/list]
[h2]Level Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Time limit for the Arena in Stage 16 has been extended by 10 seconds.
[*] Level geometry in Stage 12 has been fixed in certain places.
[*] Force Gates in Stage 9 and 12 which end Character Restriction were not displaying correctly. They should now clearly end Force Gate restrictions.
[/list]
[h2]Control Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The D-Pad should correctly switch characters according to the control mapping interface.
[/list]
[h2]Other Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've translated our Achievements into Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese, and they should display the correct language according to your system's language setting.
[*] Our Game Credits now includes Credits for our Vocal Talent
[/list]
Be sure to review the game if you haven't already. And if you would like to share feedback with the developers, always be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/RH4CZZ58NA]Join our Discord![/url]

notes.title: Clan O'Conall Dev Stream with Q&A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36909267/849b954008481fc85b46d478beef8446971fd5db.png[/img]

Join us on Twitch! [url=https://www.twitch.tv/hitgrab]https://www.twitch.tv/hitgrab[/url] at [b]8:00PM EDT on October 7th, 2020.[/b]

We're proud to release a new demo alongside the SAGF launch, and that means we'll be kicking off the event with a Livestream Demo with Developers James and Jake to run through the current build of the game and some of the great features and creatures we have in store over the week.

We're also going to be on-hand to answer questions about Clan O'Conall, our project, and the path of the game up to its release. We had a great turnout for our last event, but now we have even more to showcase.

Hop on our Twitch at the designated time and get to learn more about Clan O'Conall and the talented team behind its creation.

[h1]We've Launched on Kickstarter![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36909267/236c99fca30025a9dca7c0d3c70db5858f37d536.png[/img]

A part of the month of October events, we've also brought Clan O'Conall to Kickstarter. Indie development work in the age of COVID is difficult, and we need your support to complete the last legs of this game and polish it to perfection.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/clanoconall/clan-oconall-and-the-crown-of-the-stag]Support Us On Kickstarter![/url]

We have great rewards that will go towards a great project. We've been stunned by the show of support in our initial days, so please consider contributing to our project!

[h1]About Clan O'Conall[/h1]

Clan O’Conall is a 2D, art-driven, puzzle-platformer inspired by Celtic mythology. The game contains rapid, on-the-fly character swapping, intense combat challenges, and sprawling, puzzling expanses. Travel the land of Hibernia and save your Father from the Mother of Demons.

[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Swap between the Swordmaster, the Hunter, and the Brute and master their abilities to defeat the forces of darkness.
[*] Challenging worlds where every tree and swamp seems to bar your pass.
[*] A stunning original art style with hand-crafted environments.
[*] A narrative rooted deeply in Celtic traditions.
[*] A dynamic soundtrack by Adam Gubman
[/list]

Join the Community
Twitter -> [url=https://twitter.com/clanoconall]https://twitter.com/clanoconall[/url]

notes.title: Demo Available Now! - and other things
notes.content:
[h2]Our game demo is officially live!! [/h2]

Swap between our three heroes in the demo level and boss battle - and of course then tell your friends all about it! Make sure you play before June 22 @ 1:00PM EST because once the festival is over the demo is gone!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/843180/view/2245554624205694253]Events[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/843180/view/2245554624205503928]contests and prizes[/url] we're hosting June 16-22.

Please note we [b]strongly encourage[/b] players to use a controller while playing the game, although keyboards do work. 

[h3]Keyboard Controls [/h3](cannot be rebound/swapped at this point in time)

A & D - Move Left/Right
Spacebar - Jump
J - Attack
L - Dodge
U & I - Swap Characters

We currently have a bug with the ESC key so we highly encourage you to not press the ESC key on the keyboard (works fine with controller). We're currently working on a fix.

Hope you all enjoy the game!
